path_step: Student attempts to add an entry or reply in an inactive forum.
test_scenario: Verify that a student cannot interact with a forum that has been explicitly deactivated by the teacher.
test_case_title: Student Attempts to Interact with Inactivated Forum
pre_condition: A course exists with a forum that has been set to 'inactive' by the teacher. The student is logged in and enrolled in this course.
expected_result: Student is prevented from adding new entries or replying to existing entries in the forum (e.g., 'New Entry' and 'Reply' buttons are disabled or not visible, or a message indicates the forum is inactive).
post_condition: The forum remains inactive and the student cannot interact with it.

test_steps.step: As a Teacher, ensure a course's forum is set to 'Inactive'.
Log in as a student enrolled in the course with the inactive forum.
Navigate to the Course Details Page.
Verify that the 'New Entry' button is disabled or not visible.
Verify that 'Reply' buttons on existing entries (if any) are disabled or not visible.
Verify that a message is displayed indicating the forum is currently inactive or read-only.

uncovered_conditions: Precondition: The forum must be activated by the teacher.
